description: Inputs passed to the Safe owner/threshold policy WASM at evaluation time. The JSON-RPC endpoints themselves are policy secrets, not wasm_args.

safeAddress.description: Address of the Safe (Gnosis Safe) contract to read. getThreshold() and getOwners() are called on it.

chainId.description: Chain the Safe lives on. 11155111 = Ethereum Sepolia, 84532 = Base Sepolia. Selects which RPC-URL secret is used.

chain.description: Optional human-readable alias for chainId. Only consulted when chainId is omitted.
